title: The Beachside Haven
meta_description: Find the perfect Destin, FL vacation rental at “The Beachside Haven”, a Gulf Front luxury 6-bed, 6.5-bath vacation villa. Ideal for 12 guests, this home offers a Rooftop Pool, Theater, Elevator & 6 Bikes. Book your memorable stay now!
description_expanded: Home Highlights: - Gulf Front - Private heated rooftop pool (Pool can be heated for an additional $30 per day between Oct 1 - May 1) - Complimentary beach setups include 2 chairs and 1 umbrella - Service provided Mar 1-Oct 31 - Gated Beachfront Access - Private Theatre Room - Elevator - Soundproof dual acoustical panels and firewalls between units; soundproofing between floors; and sound mats under all levels Introducing The Beachside Haven at Henderson Beach Villas, Destin's premier gulf front development, this highly sought-after near end unit offers an expanded floor plan flooded with natural light and expansive covered outdoor spaces. With its prime gulf-front location, private rooftop pool, luxurious in-unit amenities, sophisticated design, and exclusive setting in Crystal Beach, The Beachside Haven epitomizes the epitome of coastal luxury living on the Emerald Coast. This exceptional villa boasts a private movie theatre, rooftop pool, 4 floors of outdoor space, and an in-unit elevator. Spanning 3,537 square feet with 6 bedrooms, the villa features luxurious interiors adorned with porcelain and hardwood floors, high-impact retractable glass sliders, 10' first-floor ceilings, and exquisite quartz, marble, and quartzite surfaces in the kitchen and baths. Top-of-the-line Sub-Zero and Wolf Appliances complement the custom shaker cabinets, ensuring both style and functionality. The villa's design emphasizes the beachfront experience, with see-through glass balconies and a rooftop deck offering breathtaking views of the turquoise waters. A spacious 348-square-foot ground-floor patio extends into the sugary white sands, perfect for lounging and soaking up the coastal ambiance. The 658-square-foot rooftop deck provides an ideal vantage point for witnessing Destin's legendary sunsets over the Gulf of Mexico. For added entertainment and relaxation, the villa includes a 9'x16' pool on the rooftop, accompanied by a covered cabana and storage. The private theatre room offers an immersive viewing experience with full projection and raised seating, while soundproofing features ensure privacy and tranquility throughout the home. With 2 parking spaces, gated beachfront access, and a private beach walkover, The Beachside Haven at Henderson Beach Villas promises the ultimate luxury coastal retreat. Sleeping Arrangements First Floor Queen Bedroom - Private Bathroom with Shower Only Second Floor Queen Bedroom - Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo King Bedroom - Private Bathroom with Shower Only Master Bedroom - King Bedroom - Private Bathroom with Shower and Soaking Tub Third Floor Queen Bedroom - Private Bathroom with Shower Only King Bedroom - Private Bathroom with Shower Only
